entities.summary: Lev Yakovlevich Rokhlin was a Kazakh-born Russian lieutenant general and politician who served as a member of the State Duma from 1995 until his murder in 1998. Rokhlin reached the top of the Russian military, quickly rising through the ranks during and after the Soviet–Afghan War. After the Soviet Union dissolved, he served as a commander of Russian forces during the First Chechen War. Later, he started a political career and became a member of the Russian State Duma and chairman of the State Duma's Defense Committee.
